propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeLightSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects light. HISTORY: LightSensorSensorSetPoint changed to SetPointIlluminance. Range, accuracy and time constant deleted.

properties.name: SetPointIlluminance
properties.definition: The illuminance value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.
